# Bid the trench, the outlet, and the soil.

> Price an exterior French drain from trench depth, pipe size, soil, daylight versus drywell versus storm tie-in, catch basins, downspout ties, and driveway crossings — not a published $25-a-foot special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
